title: Witness and Will
author: Sebastian Ishikawa
blurb: Yara Eriksen, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
